action.recommendation: Create /agents directory with subdirectories for each agent (security-scanner, test-writer, etc.). Create /tools for MCP tool definitions. Create /memory for context storage and vector stores. Create /evals for evaluation harnesses and test datasets. Create /prompts for prompt templates and system instructions.

rationale: Agentic systems have agent-centric folder structure with specialized subdirectories for agents, tools, memory, and evaluations. Generic structure rules conflict with this pattern.

description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration for agent tool definitions

action.recommendation: Implement MCP SDK integration in /tools directory. Define tool interface contracts, tool server startup, and tool invocation routing. Include tests for tool invocation patterns and error handling.

rationale: MCP is foundational for agentic systems; tools are stateless, tool server manages invocation, agent reasoning calls tools via MCP protocol.

action.recommendation: Implement agent orchestration layer (routing, request dispatch, multi-turn coordination). Document agent interaction patterns (sequential, parallel, hierarchical). Implement escalation logic for handling privilege boundaries.

rationale: Multi-agent systems require explicit orchestration to avoid deadlock and ensure predictable behavior.

action.recommendation: Implement adversarial testing pattern: Test Writer agent produces comprehensive test suite (TDD approach). Adversarial Evaluator agent challenges tests on coverage, quality, implementation weaknesses, and security logic. Iterate until no further challenges.

rationale: Agentic systems require multi-agent testing due to non-deterministic reasoning and long-horizon interactions.

description: Context storage and retrieval for agent reasoning

action.recommendation: Implement memory layer: scan history snapshots, result caching, retrieval for context injection. Document memory refresh policies and invalidation rules.

rationale: Agentic systems often need persistent state for multi-turn interactions and result trending.
